# Tetra

Type: Fish | Internal ID: fish4_cave | Source: Fishing | Usage: Cooking | Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Tetra are passive creatures (fish) found in the super-rare lakes at the bottom of Frost Caves of the Mountain biome.
They can be caught with a fishing rod using Cold fishing bait which can be crafted at the Food preparation table by combining 20 Fishing bait and a Fenring trophy.
Needed to craft a Fishing hat

## Notes

• Has a unique line: "It's so cold... And dark... But I like it that way."

Categorias: Fish, Fishing
